# Freight Capacity Auction Clearing Engine

Repository: https://github.com/kingsleyonoh/freight-capacity-auction-clearing-engine.git
Install: `opam switch create . 5.2.0 --deps-only --with-test` and `npm install`
Develop: `docker compose up -d postgres redis` then `dune exec bin/server.exe` and `dune exec bin/worker.exe`
Test: `dune runtest --no-buffer && dune exec tests/integration/main.exe && npx playwright test`

## Summary
Tenant-scoped freight capacity auction clearing system with explainable solver decisions, replayable policy promotion, sealed-bid privacy, and optional portfolio integrations.

## Architecture
OCaml/Dream/HTMX app backed by PostgreSQL, Redis queues, DuckDB replay store, and MiniZinc/OR-Tools process adapters.

## API Surface
See `openapi.yaml` for stubs generated from PRD §8b.

## Integrations
Optional Notification Hub, Workflow Engine, and Webhook Engine adapters are disabled by default and configured only through environment variable names in `.env.example`.
